blocks.text: Cricket update: MI London hold on to beat Phoenix but fail to progress to eliminator. MI London hang on to beat Birmingham Phoenix by just two runs, but their margin of victory isn't big enough to help them finish in the top three of the Hundred table, meaning they're eliminated despite the victory at Edgbaston.
